mapper.select: SELECT payload_fingerprint FROM inventory_outbound_documents WHERE outbound_id=#{outboundId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT l.product_id AS productId,SUM(l.quantity) AS quantity FROM inventory_outbound_documents d JOIN inventory_outbound_lines l ON l.outbound_id=d.outbound_id WHERE d.order_id=#{orderId} GROUP BY l.product_id
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_outbound_event_outbox SET published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND published_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending, COALESCE(GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(d.posted_at),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))),0) AS oldestSeconds FROM inventory_outbound_event_outbox o JOIN inventory_outbound_documents d ON d.outbound_id=o.outbound_id WHERE o.published_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_outbound_event_outbox SET next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL 5 SECOND WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND published_at IS NULL
